Title: Development and Evaluation of Gastro-Retentive Floating Drug Delivery System
Abstract: Formulation of a low-density hydrodynamically balanced floating tablet engineered for prolonged gastric residence time (12+ hours), reducing dosing frequency for ciprofloxacin and improving patient compliance under tropical storage conditions.

Title: Polyherbal Fast-Dissolving Sublingual Strips for Acute Pain Management
Abstract: Sublingual fast-dissolving polymeric thin films incorporating standardized bioactive extracts of ginger, curcumin, and clove oil for rapid buccal absorption, bypassing first-pass hepatic metabolism and achieving therapeutic onset in under 5 minutes.

Title: Bio-Based Chitosan Silver Nanocomposite Dressing for Diabetic Foot Ulcers
Abstract: Synthesis and characterization of electrostatically stabilized chitosan-silver nanoparticle hydrogel patches providing broad-spectrum antibacterial barrier protection and accelerated collagen matrix remodeling in chronic diabetic wounds.

Title: Triple-B Vitamin Fortified Pectin Gummy Delivery Vehicle for Pediatric Health
Abstract: Taste-masked pectin-based chewable gummy formulation delivering biologically active methylated B-complex vitamins (L-5-MTHF, Methylcobalamin, P-5-P) with proven shelf-stability at 40C and 75% relative humidity.

Title: AI-Powered Clinical Dosing Decision Support Toolkit for Renal Impairment
Abstract: A machine-learning pharmacokinetic algorithm integrated with local Pakistani commercial drug registries, computing personalized Cockcroft-Gault and CKD-EPI dosage adjustments in acute hospital wards.
